title: Egoroff's theorem with a closed good set in ℝⁿ
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), with Lebesgue measure Lⁿ (= volume) on its Borel σ-algebra. Let g_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) be Borel measurable. Let C ⊆ ℝⁿ be a measurable set with Lⁿ(C) < ∞ such that g_k(x) → 0 as k → ∞ for every x ∈ C. Let δ ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a closed set A ⊆ C with Lⁿ(C \ A) < δ such that g_k → 0 uniformly on A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), (∀ k, Measurable (g k)) → ∀ C : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet C → volume C ≠ ∞ → (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k => g k x) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ δ : ℝ≥0∞, δ ≠ 0 → ∃ A : Set (Rn n), A ⊆ C ∧ IsClosed A ∧ volume (C \ A) < δ ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn g (fun _ => 0) atTop A
